Frontend (Playwright): /order/infinity-family-restaurant?table=4 loads with NO salon Unsplash fallbacks — every dish/category shows 🍽️ placeholder + veg/spice tags + 15% off Barbecue chip; ADD × 2 dishes + Submit → order-success card 'Order sent to the kitchen! Order #f463e913 · Table 4 · ₹533.8'. Kitchen page (infinity.admin@miracurl.com): live-tables-panel renders live-table-{3,4,7,9} cards with correct 'N orders' count + running totals (₹722/₹1,322/₹254/₹508) and bill-table-N buttons — clicking bill-table-4 navigated to /pos with 2 open Table 4 orders merged into a single bill (BBQ Chicken Wings qty=3, Tandoori Chicken qty=2 — quantities of the same dish added across the two orders). Salon regression /book/miracurl-marathahalli still renders Unsplash salon banners + category thumbnails + salon hero copy. POS→mark-billed hook verified in code (POS.jsx L518-520 fires PUT /table-orders/mark-billed on successful checkout with kitchenOrderIdsRef).

design_issues.screen: POS after Bill Table N (merged cart)
issues: Banner toast 'Table 4 — 2 orders merged into one bill. Pick the guest & payment to close it.' is helpful but the invoice header still says 'Guest: Add Guest / Please select guest' in red before a guest is chosen — for a QR-driven flow the diner's customer_name captured on the order (e.g. 'TEST_diner') is NOT auto-prefilled into the parallel bill title (bill title shows just phone/random). Suggest surfacing table_no + captured customer_name on the parallel-bill pill.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Prefill or surface the QR-captured customer_name onto the parallel-bill title after Bill Table — currently only phone or blank shows, while the merged toast already knows the table number.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/staff_admin.py::mark_table_orders_billed uses the tenant-scoped `db` wrapper — update_many is silently no-op for orders belonging to another tenant (verified: salon admin mark-billed on a resto order returned billed=0 and the resto row stayed 'new'). Consider returning 404 when zero matched to give the frontend an explicit signal instead of {ok:true, billed:0}.
MarkBilledIn.ids is a raw `list` (not List[str]) — coerced with str() and clamped to 50; fine, but Pydantic List[str] would give 422 validation errors earlier and cheaper.
public_site.py::create_table_order applies BOTH global 'Offer of the Day' and per-category weekday special via max() — matches spec ('item takes the better one').
Frontend Kitchen.jsx billTable() dedupes items by id and sums qty across all open orders — correctly reflected in POS cart (BBQ 1+2=3, Tandoori 1+1=2 for merged Table 4).

Frontend POS.jsx L518-520: api.put('/table-orders/mark-billed', {ids}) fired with .catch(()=>{}) — silent-fail is intentional but means if the network drops, kitchen tickets stay open indefinitely without any user feedback. Consider a toast on failure.
OrderPublic.jsx unclosed-div JSX fix confirmed — page compiles and renders successfully.
Services.jsx isResto placeholder branch renders 🍽️ for both dish thumbnails and category headers — verified live on /order/{slug}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (QR order, Live Tables panel, merged POS cart, salon regression fallback images intact)

seed_data_creation: Several throwaway QR orders on tables 4/9/11 created via /public/table-order/{slug} — one billed by the resto admin during the isolation test, the rest left as open orders (Kitchen panel already had preexisting orders on tables 3/7/9).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_iter114_table_billing.py with `pytest -p no:xdist -o addopts=''` — it uses the seeded Infinity restaurant tenant_id 821532fe-cb97-4043-9075-a8420cf7d65e for isolation assertion. Frontend selectors verified: menu-add-{id}, order-table-input, order-submit-btn, order-success, live-tables-panel, live-table-{n}, bill-table-{n}. To automate a full POS checkout flow with merged cart, the Add-Guest modal must actually attach the newly-created customer to the current bill (in this run it created the customer but 'Please select guest' remained — probably a modal-flow quirk, guest picker still needed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 8 new features from the review request work end-to-end.
